text.brief: In June 2021 the analyst Decker Eveleth found about 120 missile silos under construction near Yumen in commercial satellite images.
text.record: Researchers at the Federation of American Scientists found about 110 more near Hami weeks later, and a third field appeared near Ordos. The Pentagon estimated that the Party's arsenal passed 600 operational warheads by mid-2024 and would exceed 1,000 by 2030. For decades the Party had kept a small force and a pledge of no first use as proof of restraint.
text.reading: The Party kept the look of a small and restrained force while it built a large one, which is Stratagem 27. A third major arsenal turns a two-party balance into a three-party system, and such a system sits closer to its critical point.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. American arms control assumed two nuclear peers, and no framework covered a third that refused to negotiate.
text.fix: Plan deterrence for three nuclear peers, and press for transparency measures before any cut in American forces.
